heading: বাংলাদেশের স্বাধীনতা : কূটনৈতিক যুদ্ধ
content_markdown:
৮০০
বাংলাদেশের স্বাধীনতা : কূটনৈতিক যুদ্ধ

৮৩. "In spite of the expectations of a certain segment of the society in Pakistan, none of the Muslim contries gave any substantial support to Pakistan in its hour of need. The Internal situation had deteriorated to such an extent that even believers of the same God did not feel it prudent to burn their fingers in the flames which were engulfing East Pakistan." Lt. Gen. (Retd) Kamal Matinuddin, *Tragedy of Errors East Pakistan (Crisis 1968-1971)*, Rawalpindi, 1994, p. 310.
